purpose: Teach: 改ざん/急騰/募る/整然と/名著/同好/真下/アーム

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界で、本気で、絶対、改ざん、絶対、問題、絶対、増えていますね
lines.en: In the industry, we're seeing data falsification issues increase more and more.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Slight weight on the problem itself. Professional but not distant. Even pace, no flourish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。エネルギー価格の、本気for、絶対、急騰、絶対、当社、絶対、影響受けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The energy price surge has affected our company significantly.
lines.style: Attentive, supportive tone. Nods through the agreement. Steady pacing. Light emphasis on 「affected」 to show understanding of the impact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: インターンを、本気で、絶対、募る、絶対、計画、絶対、立てましょう
lines.en: Let's put together a plan to recruit interns and build up our capacity.
lines.style: Forward-moving, decisive. Slight lift on 「plan」. Confident without being commanding. Steady eye-contact delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書庫を、本気で、絶対、整然と、絶対、整備、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're working to organize the archive system more efficiently.
lines.style: Calm, methodical report. Matter-of-fact. Unhurried, showing steady progress. Light warmth in the delivery—no apology, just update.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 経営学の、本気で、絶対、名著、絶対、社内研修、絶対、用に、絶対、選定しましょう
lines.en: We should select some business classics to use for our internal training program.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Quiet conviction on the choice. Not rushed. The tone of someone considering what will actually help people grow.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、本気で、絶対、同好、絶対、会、絶対、新設、絶対、検討、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're looking into starting a new club for staff with shared interests.
lines.style: Engaged, warm undertone. Shows care for the team. Steady, unhurried delivery. Slight emphasis on 「new」 to highlight the initiative.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本社の、本気で、絶対、真下、絶対、駐車場、絶対、空き状況、絶対、確認、絶対、お願いします
lines.en: Could you check on the parking availability directly below the main office for me?
lines.style: Polite but matter-of-fact. Slight lift on the request itself. Not demanding—conversational. Trailing slightly at the end as if opening a small door.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新型の、本気で、絶対、アーム、絶対、ロボット、絶対、導入、絶対、決定しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've decided to introduce the new robotic arm system.
lines.style: Calm, final-decision tone. Steady weight on 「decided」. Measured delivery. A moment of quiet accomplishment, not celebration.
